integrity: No independent mathematical audit or formal machine proof is claimed. Program verifies finite cases; primary full texts were compared to the new statement.
scientific_limitations: Balanced complete bipartite graphs with distinguished matching price; not unequal parts, arbitrary edge prices or other objectives. Interior optimal ratio is uniquely given by a rational stationarity equation. Unrestricted all-size claim rests on analytical argument rather than finite testing. Literature priority is best-knowledge, not exhaustive.
title: An A-versus-D support gap for a priced perfect matching in complete bipartite networks
